answers.q: When did the Howrah Bridge open?
answers.a: The Howrah Bridge in Kolkata opened to traffic in 1902. It remains one of the busiest bridges in India.

answers.q: Suggest a good book on old Bengal rivers.
answers.a: The standard work is The River Clerks of Bengal by Meera Dutta (1974). It traces how the river trade shaped the region.
